effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3. [All Turns] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [Ice-Snow] trait, by suspending this Tamer, trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. After, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
